aiplcLessons: Checkpoint-based CI prevented two control-plane/documentation issues from consuming expensive deeper lanes.
Development source/tests are accumulated before deliberate qualification; failures are batched before requalification.
Resume/release evidence metadata must advance with canonical release identity.
Major-family provenance anchor and immediate Stable predecessor are distinct identity concepts.
TEST/RC patch documentation can be represented by a strict delta while promoted/manual history remains blocking and intact.
CI efficiency may remove redundant executions but never PostgreSQL, security, race/randomized, browser, performance or native-runtime evidence.
Stable delivery requires actual macOS arm64 and Windows x64 runnable artifacts and G14/G15 evidence, not a tag or source-only PASS.
